Spell Vendors

Listed here I am compiling a list of the spells sold on each of the vendors. This will in the future enable us to not have to run to each vendor to see which one has the spell we need. I have also added a section for Other Vendors. These are vendors that are not found in the major cities. Look there for the hard to find spells. I currently do not have all the spells listed, so if you happen to be in a city and want to jot a few of the vendors and their spells down and then email me with the list.

I would like to thank Saldan Shessair, Nazureen Talismanic, and Bowan D'Black for their help in compiling these lists. Thanks!
